blocks.text: SYDNEY — A midwife testifying at a homebirths inquest has criticized authorities for arriving on the doorstep of a heavily pregnant religious woman, who’d been reluctant to engage in hospital care. The mother later lost one of her newborn twins, an inquest into four homebirth deaths has been told. The midwife, who cannot be identified for legal reasons, on Thursday said the birth went without a hitch at the woman’s home in the Hunter Valley. But one baby died in subsequent days, with a streptococcus B infection. READ: Rica Peralejo explains why she wanted to give birth at home She told […]...
